tasks.title: Linear BEC heating
tasks.statement: A linear regulator steps **{vin} V** down to **{vout} V** at **{i} A**. How many watts does it dissipate?
tasks.solution: P = (U_in − U_out)·I. That's why a linear BEC from 6S to 5 V at 1 A means 17 W of heat; you need a switching one.

tasks.title: Switching BEC input current
tasks.statement: A switching BEC with **{eta} %** efficiency delivers **{vout} V** at **{i} A** from a **{vin} V** bus. How much current does it draw from the bus (A)?
